Connecting RGU to the World

The Office of Global Affairs builds a globally engaged university ecosystem — driving international partnerships, student and faculty mobility, collaborative research, and transformative global opportunities.

Explore Opportunities Partner With Us
🌍

Vision

To build a globally engaged University ecosystem that promotes academic excellence, intercultural understanding, international collaboration, and transformative global opportunities for all stakeholders.

🚀

Mission

To create and sustain a dynamic Office of Global Affairs that drives strategic partnerships, global mobility, collaborative research, language and cultural immersion, and international student engagement in alignment with the University's vision and global aspirations.

Our Objectives

1

To establish, strengthen, and sustain strategic partnerships with reputed international universities, research institutions, and global organizations for academic cooperation, research collaboration, and institutional advancement.

2

To facilitate student and faculty mobility through exchange programmes, global immersion, pathway programmes, twinning arrangements, joint academic initiatives, internships, cultural exchange, expert member exchange and other structured international learning opportunities including research.

3

To enhance the University's global visibility, reputation, and impact through sustained international outreach, outcome-oriented partnerships, quality international programmes, and contribution to ranking and accreditation objectives.

Opportunities with the Office of Global Affairs

For Partner Universities

  • Internships — with leading corporates and Startup Incubation Centre
  • Cultural Immersion Program
  • Micro-credentials
  • Collaborative research projects / proposals

For RGU Students

  • Global Immersion Program
    • ASIAN Countries (3–5 days)
    • UK / Europe / Australia (7–10 days)
  • Semester Abroad Program
  • International Internships
  • Foreign Language Training — English, Japanese & German
  • Pathway Programs
  • Study Abroad Programs
